"Pipelining" refers to feeding the output of one function into the input of another. If $g(x)$ is the interior function and $f(x)$ is the exterior function, how is this written in algebraic notation?

```{mcq}
#| label: ocw-1-8ef
1. $fg(x)$ [hint: Sorry. Remember that the parentheses are the punctuation that says 'this is the input to the function.']
2. $g(f(x))$ [hint: No. Think about the word "interior."]
3. $f(x) + g(x)$ [hint: Nope. This is a linear combination of f(x) and g(x).]
4. $f(g(x))$ [correct]
```
:::
 <!-- end of exr-oak-close-window -->
